config.title: Basic Configuration
config.subtitle: How will you access Yuvomi?
config.existing: Existing configuration detected - your current .env file will be backed up before saving.
config.hostHint: The address you'll use to open Yuvomi in your browser.
config.errHost: Invalid hostname. Use only letters, digits, hyphens and dots.
config.errPort: Invalid port. Must be a number between 1 and 65535.
config.prereqMissing: Missing prerequisites: {{list}}. {{link}} shows how to install them.
config.errSecureOverHttp: The public address starts with http://, but this choice enforces secure cookies - nobody can sign in that way. Pick "Direct access" or use an https:// address.
config.errTz: Invalid timezone. Expected an IANA name like Europe/Berlin.

secrets.title: Security Keys
secrets.subtitle: These protect your session and encrypt the database.
secrets.dbHint: Encrypts the SQLite database at rest.
secrets.dangerWarn: Save these keys now. If you lose them, your encrypted data is unrecoverable - there is no reset. At the end of setup you can download the .env file with both keys.
secrets.preserved: Your existing keys are kept, so this setup will not lock you out of the current database. Leave a field empty to keep its key; entering a new value replaces it.

weather.title: Weather Widget
weather.subtitle: Live weather on the dashboard - free, no account, no API key.
weather.coordHint: Find coordinates on openstreetmap.org or Google Maps.

calendar.title: Calendar Sync
calendar.subtitle: Connect Yuvomi to Google Calendar, Apple iCloud or Outlook. All optional - expand to configure.
calendar.googleHint: Create OAuth credentials at {{link}}. Redirect URI: {{redirect}}
calendar.googleSelectNote: After connecting, you can choose which calendar to sync in the app settings (default: primary calendar).
calendar.appleUrlHint: Leave empty unless your provider uses a different CalDAV endpoint.
calendar.outlookHint: Create a free Entra ID app registration ("Personal Microsoft accounts only") at {{link}} - see the installation guide. Redirect URI: {{redirect}}
calendar.outlookNote: One-way push: Yuvomi stays the source of truth - changes made in Outlook are overwritten. Family accounts are connected later in the app settings.

review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Check your settings before writing .env and starting the container.
review.finalNote: This writes your .env (an existing one is backed up) and starts the container.

docker.title: Starting Yuvomi
docker.subtitle: Pulling the image and starting the Docker container.
docker.firstRunHint: The first run can take several minutes.
docker.stalled: This is taking longer than usual. The log below shows why.
docker.timedOut: No response after 15 minutes. Check the log and try again.

admin.title: Create Admin Account
admin.subtitle: Set up your first login. This account has full access to Yuvomi.
admin.errPass: Password must be at least 8 characters.

done.title: Yuvomi is ready!
done.subtitle: Your family planner is running and your admin account is set up.
done.backupReminder: Remember to back up your .env file now - it holds your keys.
done.downloadFailed: The file could not be loaded - the installer has most likely shut down already. Your keys are in the .env file on your server.
done.serverStops: The installer shuts down a few minutes from now. Download the file before you close this tab.
done.nextInviteDesc: Create invitation links so everyone picks their own password.
done.nextModulesDesc: Turn on what your household actually uses and hide the rest.
done.nextInstallDesc: Open Yuvomi on a phone and add it to the home screen - it works offline.
done.subtitleExisting: Yuvomi is running. This installation already has an administrator account - sign in with your existing credentials.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.subtitle: Single sign-on, access to your home network, and a few fine adjustments. All optional.
advanced.proxyBehindHttps: Behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS (Caddy, nginx, Traefik)
advanced.proxyHint: Pick "Direct access" if you open Yuvomi over http:// - otherwise you cannot sign in. Behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS, pick the first option.
advanced.oidcHint: Fill in all four fields to enable SSO, or leave them empty.
advanced.errOidc: OIDC requires all four fields or none.
advanced.backupScheduleHint: When to run backups. Default: daily at 2 AM.
advanced.documentWebdavHint: Non-empty environment values override the corresponding settings stored in the database.
advanced.documentWebdavPathHint: Remote folder for document files. Leave empty to use yuvomi-documents.
advanced.documentLocalEnable: Store new documents in a local folder
advanced.documentLocalPathHint: Path inside the container. Leave empty to use /documents.
advanced.errSchedule: Invalid cron schedule (expected five space-separated fields, e.g. 0 2 * * *).
advanced.errKeep: Backups to keep must be a positive number.
advanced.webdavBackupHint: Copy each backup to a WebDAV server (e.g. Nextcloud) so it survives a disk failure.
advanced.fixerHint: Optional. Converts subscription currencies with live rates. Subscriptions work without it.
advanced.pushSubjectHint: Sent to push services as a contact for your server. Leave empty to use the default.
advanced.documentGoogleDriveHint: Configure OAuth credentials here, then connect and explicitly select Google Drive in Document settings after installation.
advanced.documentGoogleDriveReuseHint: Leave both empty to reuse your Google Calendar OAuth credentials. To use dedicated ones, create them in the Google Cloud Console (as in the Calendar step).
advanced.errDocumentGoogleDrivePair: Google Drive client ID and secret must both be set or both be empty.
advanced.errDocumentGoogleDriveCredentials: Google Drive requires either its own client ID and secret or configured Google Calendar credentials.
advanced.dataDirHint: Where the database and app data live on the server. Leave empty to use ./data next to the compose file.
advanced.documentLocalDirHint: The folder on the server that gets mounted into the container. Leave empty to use ./documents.
advanced.documentWebdavPrivateNetwork: Allow a WebDAV target on your home network
advanced.documentWebdavPrivateNetworkHint: Needed for a Nextcloud on your own network. Lifts the SSRF protection for this target.
advanced.icsPrivateNetwork: Allow calendar subscriptions from your home network
advanced.icsPrivateNetworkHint: Needed for ICS feeds from devices on your own network. Lifts the SSRF protection for calendar subscriptions.
advanced.recipeProviderPrivateNetwork: Allow recipe provider mirrors on your home network
advanced.recipeProviderPrivateNetworkHint: Needed for a Mealie or Tandoor instance on your own network. Lifts the SSRF protection for recipe provider mirrors.
advanced.wasteSourcePrivateNetwork: Allow waste collection feeds on your home network
advanced.wasteSourcePrivateNetworkHint: Needed for a municipal waste calendar mirrored on your own network. Lifts the SSRF protection for waste collection URL sources.
advanced.oidcTrustEmail: Trust email without a verified claim
advanced.oidcTrustEmailHint: Only enable this if your provider does not send email_verified and you trust it.
advanced.oidcAllowSignup: Let SSO sign-ins create new accounts
advanced.oidcAllowSignupHint: Turn this off when your provider serves more people than this household. Existing accounts still sign in and still get linked.
advanced.baseUrlHint: The address your family opens Yuvomi at - not the container's host and port. Used for password reset and invitation links.
advanced.syncIntervalHint: How often Yuvomi syncs calendars and contacts. Raise it if your provider rate-limits you.
advanced.errSyncInterval: Enter a positive whole number of minutes.
advanced.privateNetworkHint: Yuvomi refuses connections to addresses on your own network by default, which protects against a server being tricked into reaching internal services. Enable what you actually run at home.
advanced.authPasswordLogin: Keep the username and password login
advanced.authPasswordLoginHint: Turning this off makes SSO the only way in: the login form and password reset disappear. It takes effect once at least one account is linked to your provider, so a fresh install can still create its first admin. If your provider becomes unreachable, the way back is editing the .env file and restarting.

welcome.title: Welcome to Yuvomi
welcome.subtitle: Let's get your private family planner running. Choose how you'd like to set it up.
welcome.simpleDesc: We handle the technical details for you. Perfect for running Yuvomi at home.
welcome.advancedDesc: Full control: reverse proxy, calendar sync, email, single sign-on and backups.
welcome.existingLocked: An existing installation was detected. Continue with the advanced setup so your current settings are kept.
welcome.containerRunning: Yuvomi is currently running. Saving will restart the container, so it will be briefly unavailable.

simple.title: Ready to go
simple.subtitle: We've prepared everything with safe defaults. Just create your account next.
simple.itemKeysDesc: Your session and database are encrypted automatically.
simple.itemBackupsDesc: A local backup is kept every night.
simple.backupReminder: After setup, back up the generated .env file - it holds your only encryption keys.
simple.switchAdvanced: Need more options? Switch to advanced setup

email.title: Email & Password Reset
email.subtitle: Let family members reset a forgotten password by email. Optional - skip if you don't need it.
email.hint: Uses your own SMTP server (mailbox provider, self-hosted, or a transactional service).
email.fromHint: The "from" address recipients will see. Many providers require it to match your username.
email.errIncomplete: SMTP server and sender address are required.

storage.title: Storage & backups
storage.subtitle: Where your data lives on the server, and where copies of it go. All optional - the defaults work.
